Kernel and Aljeter firmware checkouts, release checkpoints, modules and ccache
are retained between local builds. They are disposable and ignored by Git.

firmware comes from `https://gitlab.com/vanadium-oss/motorola-msm8953/mainline/sanders-firmware.git`.
